newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds fell in week.

text.p: Assets of the nation's 663 retail money market mutual funds fell $3.02 billion to $584.37 billion in the week ended Sept. 25, the Investment Company Institute, said Thursday.

The industry trade group said assets of the 407 taxable money market funds in the retail category fell $1.24 billion to $477.19 billion, while assets of the 256 tax-exempt funds fell $1.78 billion to $107.17 billion.

It said assets of the 306 institutional money market funds fell $11.22 billion to $262.33 billion. Of these, the 244 taxable money market fund assets fell $10.65 billion to $234.43 billion, and assets of the 62 tax exempt funds fell $557 million to $27.90 billion.
Money market mutual fund assets stood at $846.70 billion in the week. Assets for the week ended Sept. 18 were revised to $860.94 billion from $860.90 billion.
